display_name: Tri SSL source-U channel consistency four arms
description: Four predeclared channel perturbations: bounded CFO phase ramp, one-sample echo, three-sample echo, and CFO plus three-sample echo. Three matched model seeds each; consistent on all actual branches. Prior Main target outcomes exposed; no blind or test-driven selection claim.

roles.U_s: 56700 source IQ with TX labels hidden

permissions.claim_scope: Phase1 terrestrial proxy; direct recognition; no future-date or in-orbit claim

checkpoint.initialization: Same-seed original Tri SSL source-only scratch E20; each arm own E10+E20
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: same F0 source contract; no target or U truth use
checkpoint.selection_rule: All 12 fixed final E50 and all scenes; do not change matrix after scores; prior target exposure disclosed

expected_artifacts: 12 E50 checkpoints and source-U acceptance counters
all 12 seven-scene predictions frozen before scoring
paired per-scene Tri/PL, TX/RX/day corrected and missed, runtime and failure analysis
